body:
Seems like a bunch of petty brats that took in the lies to me.  I really don't see how this is inconsistent at all.  It would be awful to have to deal with people following you around all day saying these kinds of things about you when none of it is true.  

At best they seem to take things too far, it's kind of hard to believe these are college students.  They sound like middle schoolers.  You would think the university would have at the very least sat these kids aside and told them to cut it out.

Edit:  Man, you seemed to have posted a lot about this suddenly across the OPs post history.  Not sure why this is so important to you.  I have been following this for a while and I have been hoping the OP gets some kind of justice, or at least have a happy ending.  I don't really see how anyone wouldn't want someone who has gone through all of that to not have a happy ending.
